Mei Huang  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-54-123-4567 | mei.huang@example.com  

Professional Summary  
A detail-oriented frontend engineer with a focus on healthtech innovation, dedicated to creating intuitive, accessible interfaces that prioritize user experience. Leveraged modern frameworks and performance optimization techniques to deliver scalable solutions for healthcare platforms. Committed to aligning technical execution with business goals, ensuring seamless integration of design and functionality.  

Professional Experience  
**Junior Frontend Developer**  
HealthTrack Innovations (2023–Present)  
Developed and maintained responsive web interfaces for patient monitoring tools, emphasizing accessibility compliance and cross-browser compatibility. Collaborated with designers to implement UI components using React and Next.js, ensuring consistent styling and performance across devices. Optimized page load times by implementing lazy loading and code splitting, contributing to a 25% reduction in average render time. Integrated state management solutions (Zustand) to streamline data flow between components, improving maintainability. Conducted code reviews and mentored junior developers, fostering a culture of best practices.  

**Web Developer Intern**  
MedTech Solutions (2022)  
Contributed to the development of a telehealth platform by building reusable UI components with React, ensuring scalability and modularity. Partnered with backend engineers to establish RESTful API integrations, enhancing data synchronization between frontend and backend systems. Implemented accessibility features adhering to WCAG 2.1 guidelines, including ARIA labels and keyboard navigation, to ensure inclusive user access. Utilized Browser DevTools for debugging and performance profiling, identifying and resolving critical bottlenecks in application workflows.  

Education  
**Bachelor of Science in Computer Science**  
University of Washington (2018–2022)  
Graduated with a focus on software engineering and human-computer interaction, emphasizing the intersection of technology and healthcare.  

Technical Skills  
- **React**: Built dynamic, data-driven interfaces for health monitoring dashboards, ensuring real-time updates and user engagement.  
- **Next.js**: Developed server-rendered pages for improved SEO and performance, reducing bounce rates on patient-facing tools.  
- **Responsive Design**: Created adaptive layouts for mobile and desktop users, prioritizing usability in diverse healthcare environments.  
- **State Management (Redux/Zustand)**: Managed complex data flows in application state, enabling efficient component communication.  
- **TypeScript**: Enhanced type safety in codebases, reducing runtime errors and improving collaboration with cross-functional teams.  
- **Web Accessibility (WCAG)**: Implemented accessible design patterns, ensuring compliance with global standards for inclusive healthcare technology.  
- **Web Performance Optimization**: Reduced asset load times through image optimization and caching strategies, enhancing user experience.  
- **Browser DevTools**: Diagnosed and resolved frontend issues, including memory leaks and rendering anomalies, during development and production phases.  

Projects  
**HealthTrack Patient Portal**  
Designed and deployed a web application for managing patient records, integrating React and Next.js to ensure fast, secure data access. Focused on accessibility and performance, achieving a 90% compliance score on Lighthouse audits.  

**MedTech Solutions Telehealth Platform**  
Contributed to a scalable telehealth interface, emphasizing real-time video conferencing and secure data handling. Implemented responsive design principles to ensure usability across all device types.  

Languages  
English (professional proficiency), Hebrew (basic conversational)
